title: The sharp finite-field Nikodym exponent
abstract: Proves a lower bound for Nikodym sets over arbitrary finite fields and a matching exponent upper construction over sufficiently large prime fields, using interpolation, algebraic degree bounds, and multiquadratic constructions.

informal.Nikodym.card_ge_pow_sub: Every Nikodym set in dimension d ≥ 2 over a finite field of size q has size at least q^d − (8d²+1)q^(d−2^(1−d)).
informal.Nikodym.exists_isNikodym_card_le: For every positive ε and dimension d ≥ 2, sufficiently large prime fields admit a Nikodym set of size at most q^d − q^(d−2^(1−d)−ε).
